name: Dapple-Horned Besul
desc: Dapple-Horned Besul is a Gremor NPC. She is the leader of the Navaen settlement at Meteor Isle.
additional_info:
-   Besul's racial variant appears to be the 'Cedar' variant of a Gremor, with deep purple sclerae instead of the faint Purple.
-   Besul wears the Navaen War Chief Outfit.
